title: Cabin quietness and road noise
summary: This topic centers on cabin quietness and road noise, but several sampled fragments also drift into unrelated comments about vehicle size or power.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the cabin is very quiet or noticeably quieter than comparison vehicles, especially in electric driving.

negative.summary: Negative feedback mentions excessive road noise and a wish for a quieter ride.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples include statements about being noticeably quieter versus a prior model, while others are too ambiguous or discuss bigger size or more power instead of noise.

limitations: Most sampled reviews are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster mixes quietness and road-noise comments with unrelated remarks about vehicle size and power.
Examples are few and stratified, so they should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews on this topic.
